title: The comparison unit is an isomorphism
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme. For every sheaf of sets $F$ on $X_{\Et}$ the unit
$\eta_F\colon F	o
u_{X,*}
u_X^*F$ is an isomorphism. Consequently
$
u_X^*\colon\Sh(X_{\Et})	o\Sh(X_{\Proet})$ is fully faithful: for sheaves
$F,F'$ on $X_{\Et}$ the map
$\Hom(F,F')	o\Hom(
u_X^*F,
u_X^*F')$, $\varphi\mapsto
u_X^*\varphi$, is
bijective.

proof.text:
Fix a sheaf of sets $F$ on $X_{\Et}$ and an arbitrary etale object $h:V	o X$. By [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $(
u_{X,*}
u_X^*F)(V)=(
u_X^*F)(V)$. Apply [lem-cbc-comparison-pullback-sections] to this object: its section isomorphism identifies this set with $\Gamma(V_{\Et},h_{\Et}^{-1}F)$, and, importantly, its last sentence identifies the actual comparison unit with the usual identification on etale objects. By [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-restriction], $h_{\Et}^{-1}F$ identifies with $F|_V$, whose value at the identity object is $F(V)$. Thus the composite $F(V)\xrightarrow{\eta_F(V)}(
u_X^*F)(V)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(V_{\Et},h_{\Et}^{-1}F)\xrightarrow{\sim}F(V)$ sends every $s$ to $s$. All three nodes concern sheaves of sets; no abelian-category or coefficient-ring assumption is imposed. In particular $\eta_F(V)$ is bijective.

proof.text:
For every etale object $V$, let $b_V$ be the inverse bijection of $\eta_F(V)$ obtained in step 1. For an arrow $a:W	o V$, naturality of $\eta_F$ gives $(
u_*
u^*F)(a)\eta_F(V)=\eta_F(W)F(a)$. Multiply on the left by $b_W$ and on the right by $b_V$ to obtain $b_W(
u_*
u^*F)(a)=F(a)b_V$. The $b_V$ therefore define a morphism of sheaves inverse to $\eta_F$, with both inverse identities checked on every object. This proves that the unit is an isomorphism for arbitrary $X$, including the empty scheme.

proof.text:
The adjunction $
u_X^*\dashv
u_{X,*}$ of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] sends a morphism $\psi:
u_X^*F	o
u_X^*F'$ to $
u_{X,*}(\psi)\circ\eta_F$ and is a bijection $\Hom(
u_X^*F,
u_X^*F')\cong\Hom(F,
u_{X,*}
u_X^*F')$. For $\psi=
u_X^*\varphi$, naturality of the unit gives $
u_{X,*}
u_X^*(\varphi)\circ\eta_F=\eta_{F'}\circ\varphi$. Postcomposition with the isomorphism $\eta_{F'}$ is a bijection, with inverse postcomposition with $\eta_{F'}^{-1}$. Hence the comparison map on Hom sets, whose composite with the adjunction bijection is this postcomposition map, is itself bijective. Explicitly its inverse sends $\psi$ to $\eta_{F'}^{-1}\circ
u_{X,*}(\psi)\circ\eta_F$.
